Author: FranFkntastic
Name: MarketMafioso
Punchline: Player handoff, cross-world market buying, and Free Company workshop production.
Description: Player handoff, cross-world market buying, and Free Company workshop production. Hand items to another player through the Trade Queue, turn a shopping list into a cross-world buying run with Market Acquisition, and plan workshop projects and their materials across bags and retainers. An optional self-hosted Workshop Host adds inventory history, a browser dashboard, and work orders.
